reason: The report uses an unadjusted regression on a sample trimmed at the top and bottom 1% of the outcome (N=1960), with no controls for the pre-period outcome (export_growth_2020) or other 2020 covariates. When I re-ran it on the full sample (N=2000) with all pre-period controls, the supplier_diversity coefficient fell from about 1.5 to 0.05 (SE 0.25), so the claimed positive effect is confounding rather than a supported result. None of the controls I added were measured after the treatment period; buyer_rating_2023 was left out because it is post-treatment.
